li.label: Slept with a soft toy!
li.description: I got to go to sleep while snuggled up with my softest best friend, i felt so safe because they protected me!

li.label: No soft cuddle buddy?!
li.description: I had to sleep all alone without a soft friend to keep me safe! I felt so lonely and scared because what if a giant monster came and tried to eat me up? Who would keep me safe?!

li.label: I wanna be out!
li.description: Im starting to get kinda really bored in here, theres not much to do but wiggle!

li.label: Stupid crib...
li.description: This isnt fair!!! I wanna go out of my crib but they wont let me!! I wanna go play toys!!!

li.label: I want to be let out of my crib!
li.description: I'm stuck in my crib! I wanna be let out but no one is coming to get me!!! There's so much fun stuff out there and I wanna go play with it!

li.label: Was locked in my crib
li.description: I'm finally out of my crib, but i'm still upset that the grown ups wouldn't let me out for so long! I was so boring in there! There was nothing to doooo! I hate my crib! im never getting back in there again, I wanna play forever!!

li.label: Locked in!!! Not fair!!!
li.description: They put me in my crib and locked it so i cant get out!! This is so mean!! I just wanna go play with my toys and run around but they wont let me!! I dont like my crib anymore!! I wanna be free!!!

li.label: Slept with my favorite toy
li.description: I got to cuddle with my favorite toy while I slept. It made me feel so safe and loved. I had such sweet dreams!

li.label: No toy to cuddle
li.description: I had to sleep without my favorite toy to cuddle. I felt lonely and a bit scared. I wish I had something soft to hold onto.

li.label: Slept with a comfort item
li.description: There's something quietly comforting about having a soft, familiar toy nearby while I sleep. I won't admit it to anyone, but it helped me sleep a little easier.

li.label: Missed my comfort item
li.description: I wanted something soft to hold onto while I slept, but couldn't find one. It's a small thing, but I felt it.

li.label: This bed is way too big!
li.description: This bed is way way way to big, it makes me feel so small and scared. There isn't even any walls! What if i fall off, id go SPLAT on the ground! Its so big that I'm scared a monster is gonna come find me and eat me up for dinner! I miss my crib!
